facts.fact: World Bank appraisal document says only 30,000 km of terrestrial fiber is deployed in Nigeria, a quarter of the 120,000 km its ministry blueprint identifies; date is the document date.
World Bank appraisal document states there is no national backbone network in Nigeria, leading to duplicate deployments by individual operators; date is the document date.

note: Conflicting statements (30,000 km deployed vs no national network) both recorded; SPV will offer wholesale open access, a plan.
